plain_english: SearchPosition independently rejects actual library order, future event, and future random-outcome fields.
BoundedExplorer rejects a single request containing nine belief-sample seeds because the frozen maximum is eight.
A counted expansion callback proves that the invalid request is rejected before any sample position is generated.
title: Policy and search reject hidden library and future information before expansion
